title: Install-toast spam - a burst of completion toasts for work that is not happening
description:
UMBRELLA: MPI-513 - Install state that lies to the user (consolidation sweep 2026-08-14). Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-513/plan.md.

Seen during the 2026-08-11 download-Pod incident: a burst of install toasts for work that was not happening. NEVER REPRODUCED, so it is carded rather than fixed - no evidence, no speculative patch.

Two dead ends already ruled out, do not re-walk them: (1) it is NOT the MPI-539 reconcile path - the client's download:complete handler already drops events with no modelId, and that path broadcasts modelId:null; (2) it is not the abandon path, which now goes terminal exactly once per model job.

First candidate: a MODEL-LEVEL download:complete re-broadcast when the install SSE reconnects and replays. The snapshot protocol (MPI-276 G9) versions deltas, but a replayed terminal event is not a delta.

Evidence to capture next time it fires, before touching code: the app.log download lines around the burst, and whether the SSE reconnected in that window. Parked out of 1.4.1 with the umbrella's agreement - unreproduced means unfixable, not ignored.
